text: VARNHOLT, March 18 — Varnholt Logistics appointed Ilse Marrenkamp as chief executive in March, replacing interim head Jorrit Veen after a two-month search, people familiar with the matter said. Marrenkamp, 52, previously led the freight division at Nordbay Cargo and is expected to take over day-to-day operations on April 1, they said. The company’s board approved the move earlier this month, according to the people, who asked not to be named because the decision was not publicly announced. Varnholt, which handles warehousing and regional distribution across the Kestrel Corridor, reported revenue of 1.4 billion guilders last year and has been seeking a turnaround after a series of delayed contract renewals.
